The '''Iridium Sprinkler''' is a [[crafting|crafted]] item that waters the 24 adjacent tiles every morning (a 5x5 area). Only tilled tiles will be watered. The Iridium Sprinkler is unlocked at [[Farming]] level 9.  

One Iridium Sprinkler can be purchased from [[Krobus]] for {{Price|10000}} every Friday.  One to two Iridium Sprinklers may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. An Iridium Sprinkler may also randomly be a reward from [[Mayor's_Manor#Prize Machine|Mayor Lewis' Prize Machine]], in exchange for a [[Prize Ticket]].

A [[Torch]] can be placed on an Iridium Sprinkler to provide minimal lighting in the dark.

[[Crafting#Sprinklers|Sprinklers]] cannot be used to water [[Garden Pot]]s or the [[Animals#Cat or Dog|pet's]] water bowl. Sprinklers cannot be placed on sand.
